title: MOTION (RAMAN - BLUMENFIELD ) relative to funding for the design and construction of ADA-compliant curb ramps and associated roadway and sidewalk…
text:
[Council File 26-1642; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RAMAN - BLUMENFIELD ) relative to funding for the design and construction of ADA-compliant curb ramps and associated roadway and sidewalk engineering at the intersections of Cahuenga Boulevard / Broadlawn Drive and Cahuenga Boulevard / Oakshire Drive.
Recommendations for Council actions, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $456,500 from the Cash Balance of the Ventura/Cahuenga Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan Fund No. 523/94, to the following Bureau of Street Services accounts, as detailed in the Motion, attached to the Council file, to complete the design and construction of ADA-compliant curb ramps and associated roadway and sidewalk engineering at the intersections of Cahuenga Boulevard / Broadlawn Drive and Cahuenga Boulevard / Oakshire Drive.
2. AUTHORIZE the Controller to transfer any unspent funds after project completion back to the Ventura / Cahuenga Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan Fund No. 523.
3. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
